subject: Bug report: scheduled reports sent to wrong recipients
body:
Hello support,

We found a serious issue with scheduled reports.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Create a scheduled report with recipient list A.
2. Duplicate the report and change the recipients to list B.
3. Wait for the next scheduled run.

Expected: report 1 goes to list A, report 2 goes to list B.
Actual: both reports go to list B.

This means patient-volume reports went to an external partner who should not see them. We have paused all schedules for now. Please treat this as a priority and confirm once it's fixed.

Isabel Fontaine
IT Coordinator, Clearbrook Clinic

subject: RFP: Intelligent document intake for claims processing
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Alderbank Insurance is issuing a request for proposal for an intelligent document intake solution. Our claims department receives approximately 2,500 documents per week via email, including claim forms, photographs, repair estimates and medical reports. At present, each document is opened, classified and keyed into our claims system manually by a team of six.

We are seeking a solution that will:
1. Automatically classify incoming documents by type;
2. Extract key fields (policy number, claim date, amount claimed);
3. Route each document to the correct handler queue;
4. Provide an audit trail suitable for regulatory review.

The approved budget for phase one is £40,000-55,000. We expect the solution to be in production within 4 months of contract signature.

Please confirm your intention to respond by replying to this email. Full RFP documentation will follow under NDA.

Yours faithfully,
Jonathan Pryce
Head of Claims Transformation
Alderbank Insurance
